sentences.text: 2. This is an application seeking to quash the First Information Report relating to Crime No.251/2023, registered with Police Station Ansing, District Washim for an offence punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. It is submitted that since the husband has filed divorce petition, in retaliation, false report has been lodged.
Particularly it is argued that entire family has been implicated on the basis of false and vague allegations.

4. Issue notice to the non-applicants, returnable on 20.12.2023.
5.
Ms. Shamsi Haider, learned APP waives service of notice for non-applicant No.1/State.
6. In the meantime, investigation shall go on, but the charge-sheet shall not be filed without obtaining leave of this Court.
